author: Second Wind
description:
Walt Disney has announced an animated revival of Firefly featuring the original cast. That's probably not a good thing.
Darren Mooney discusses why shows like Firefly get revived, what gets lost when you resurrect a piece of pop culture twenty years removed from its original context, and why maybe it's okay for some things to just end.
Spoilers for Firefly and Serenity throughout.
